test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: One pipe can fill a tank in 9 minutes while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 18 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-half of the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Filling time = 9 minutes

Emptying time = 18 minutes

Required work = 1/2 tank

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total work ÷ Time

Net efficiency = Sum of individual efficiencies

Time = Work ÷
